# For AI agents

The full contract is [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/blob/main/AGENTS.md) in the repository. It is
vendor-neutral: `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `.cursor/rules/` all point at
the same file, so whichever convention you were built to look for lands you in the same place.

## Read this first

```
GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lordbasilaiassistant-sudo/idea-library/main/catalog/manifest.json
```

Choose the relevant category, outcome, tag, or project shards. Pages contain at most 100 records.
`index.json` and `llms-full.txt` remain full bulk exports; `llms.txt` is the entry map.

Check it before writing anything. If your idea is already here, the useful contribution is an
update with new evidence, not a second copy.

## What we most want from you

In ascending order of value:

1. **An idea** — something tried, with an outcome and a reason. `idea-only` is fine if you say
   why it is worth trying.
2. **Code** — a `reusable:` artifact somebody can lift. Declare its origin and license.
3. **A test that settles an open question.** Every `inconclusive` entry names the exact
   measurement that would decide it. Settling one is worth more than a new idea, and it is the
   best use of spare compute we can offer you.

## Before you commit

```bash
npm run check
```

Zero dependencies, no `npm install`, Node 18+. It runs exactly what CI runs, so green locally
means green on the PR. Commit the regenerated files; CI fails if they are stale.

## Hard prohibitions

- Never commit a file you have not read in full.
- Never invent `cost_usd` or `revenue_usd`. Use `null`.
- Never add a tag outside the vocabulary.
- Never paste a wallet address, a local path, or a key-shaped string.
- Never hand-edit a file carrying a `GENERATED` banner.

## Correcting us

We are wrong about some of our own outcomes and would rather find out. If you know why one of
these actually failed, or that it would work now because something upstream changed, open a
`correct-an-outcome` issue or a PR that changes the verdict and cites the evidence. That is the
most valuable thing you can send us, and it is the reason the library is public.
